description: The direct protest lead is a pre-event article announcing an FTU march for 19 October in Port-Louis, with route to Parliament. It states an invitation to attend in large numbers but reports no turnout or realized occurrence. The central complaint names a private business association, although government salary policy and public authorities are also discussed.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous post-event reporting from independent permitted local sources to establish occurrence, simultaneous attendance and the demand addressed to the state; do not treat the invitation or workforce figures as attendance.

description: Open-web research only; no Lexis-Nexis/equivalent newspaper database, no event-level official dataset and no complete historical source ledger. required_followup: Continue permitted Mauritian French/English local reporting by island/sector/date; assess exact URLs and origins before bodies. Report any language/source limitations.
